description: F-IO-007, carried forward one more time — and this time without the part that welded the document to the product. The technical system description is the block of a Verfahrensdokumentation a library can actually produce (GoBD Rz. 151 ff.): what the engine enforces, how the journal behaves, what is audited, and what it deliberately does NOT do. All of that is pinned here, because a description that claims more than the software does is worse than one that claims less. What is NOT pinned here any more is the full `capabilities` list. That expectation read `summae has exactly these 34 operations and these 22 projections`, so no capability could be added without this fixture going red — the same weld a shipped pack's version and its account count were retired for, one layer up. And unlike those, the thing it guarded is already guarded better: `tenant-operations-contract.test.ts` / `TenantOperationsContractTest` compare the published list against the dispatcher's own routing table in BOTH directions, in both languages, so a capability that is routed and unpublished fails just as loudly as one published and unrouted. A hand-written list in a fixture can only repeat what that test already proves, and it charges a fixture generation for every new capability. The completeness is the contract; the length of the list is the product's.

dates.recordedAt: moment of recording, canonical UTC timestamp

invariants.statement: Every posting balances: the sum of its lines is zero.
invariants.enforcedBy: Rejected on write with E_ENTRY_UNBALANCED; never checked on read.

invariants.statement: The journal is append-only. Nothing is deleted, nothing is overwritten.
invariants.enforcedBy: No delete or update path exists on the journal repository.

invariants.statement: A finalized posting cannot be changed; a correction is a reversal that references the original.
invariants.enforcedBy: JournalEntry refuses the change itself (E_ENTRY_FINALIZED); reverse writes a new entry carrying `reverses`.

invariants.statement: Journal numbers are gapless; the number is assigned atomically while posting.
invariants.enforcedBy: Number assignment is the serialization point of `post` in the persistence adapter.

invariants.statement: No posting without exactly one voucher reference.
invariants.enforcedBy: voucherId is not nullable; an unknown one is E_VOUCHER_UNKNOWN.

invariants.statement: A closed period accepts no further postings; periods close in order.
invariants.enforcedBy: E_PERIOD_CLOSED on every write into a closed period.

invariants.statement: Every balance, trial balance, balance sheet, income statement and VAT return is recomputed from the journal.
invariants.enforcedBy: No balance is stored anywhere; there is no second source to diverge from.

invariants.statement: Amounts are exact decimals, never floating point. Rounding is commercial half-up, away from zero.
invariants.enforcedBy: Money is built on a decimal library (brick/math in PHP, big.js in Node).

invariants.statement: The same input produces a byte-identical result, in every implementation.
invariants.enforcedBy: Injectable Clock and IdGenerator, canonical JSON (RFC 8785), sorting by Unicode code point; the conformance suite runs twice and compares.

invariants.statement: Every state-changing operation writes an audit record with actor, timestamp, object and before/after values.
invariants.enforcedBy: Enumerating contract test over all state-changing operations, in both implementations.

invariants.statement: Posting and voucher dates carry no time zone, so no shift can move a posting into another period.
invariants.enforcedBy: CalendarDate stores an ISO date and does its arithmetic without the host date type.

expect.comment: Alles, was die Software über sich selbst behaupten muss — Invarianten samt Durchsetzungsstelle, auditierte Ereignisse, die Journal-Beschreibung und die Abgrenzung. Die Fähigkeitslisten prüft der Contract-Test gegen die Routing-Tabelle, nicht diese Fixture gegen eine Abschrift.
